customerio.focus: Tailored for Customer.io: AI-written messages, approval flows, and when a human stays in the loop.

why.title: Why Customer.io
why.body: Your agent drafts messages that your customers' customers will read. Deciding when that kind of output can go out without a human is the call I've already made at work, on 54,000+ real outputs. Gatekeeper, the side project I'm building now, asks the same question for AI-drafted lifecycle messages.
